reader_terms.plain_meaning: The ten questions the guide answers, from orchestration boundary to safe contribution.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The exact facts and rules held fixed for one semantic evaluation.

inference: The page names the relationship as a research-dispatch-to-reasoning bridge for scanning.
The page groups detailed rules into known context, new responsibility, analogy stops, and comprehension.
The page presents the ten composition parts as one learning path.
Arrows mean writing dependency, not software calls.
The page places both repositories and teammate review outside the schema boundary.
The ten cards are a teaching order; the research lifecycle shown in the first card is an example, never an active dispatch or integrated runtime path.
The timeline marks teammate review as the current human-owned step.
The page elevates research-evidence inflation and cross-project false equivalence as the main onboarding risks.
Four toggles remain the smallest useful isolation controls for purpose, path, dependencies, and guardrails.
